description: A three-day return forecaster in which the target reaches the feature matrix by four separate routes.

expected.note: The FEATURES allow-list contains fwd_ret_3d_ma, a moving average of the target.
signal_strength is a rolling mean of the target under a name that hides it.
Subtractive construction: the drop removes date/ticker/close and leaves the target in X.
The scaler is fitted on the whole panel, target column included.
